brief: Ukraine's commercial payments/banking research landscape splits into four distinct actor types rather than one market. Global publishers (GlobalData, Euromonitor Passport, Statista, plus resellers ResearchAndMarkets and MarketResearch.com) sell English-language Ukraine cards-and-payments sizing whose free abstracts, TOCs and press releases already expose headline KPIs and issuer/scheme structure; no Ukraine-specific commercial ATM/POS hardware report was found, so regional Mordor POS reports are the nearest proxy. Domestically, value concentrates in rating agencies (Standard-Rating's recurring banking-sector stability diagnostics, IBI-Rating, Expert-Rating, Rurik) and in survey houses — above all Info Sapiens, which publishes free full-PDF national financial-behaviour and inclusion studies that are the only real demand-side source on cash versus card habits. Big Four local practices (Deloitte, PwC, KPMG, EY) and commercial data vendors (YouControl's Bank FinScore, Opendatabot, Bankografo) round out the map, mostly by re-normalising NBU data — which means their methodology sections are themselves a reliable pointer to the primary statistical series worth collecting directly.
